description: This file contains unit tests for pairing file helper functions, including path resolution, pruning expired entries, and reconciling pending pairing requests.

methods.name: resolvePairingPaths
methods.description: Resolves and constructs various file paths within a given directory for device pairing files.

methods.name: pruneExpiredPending
methods.description: Removes pending entries older than a specified TTL from the pendingById object.

methods.name: reconcilePendingPairingRequests
methods.description: Synchronizes pending pairing requests by updating existing requests or creating new ones based on incoming data.

ctags.name: existing
ctags.pattern: /^    const existing = { requestId: "req-1", deviceId: "device-1", ts: 1, version: 1 };$/
